sections.Clinical details: 62-year-old woman presenting with obstructive jaundice. Imaging demonstrated a mass in the head of the pancreas. Pancreaticoduodenectomy was performed.
sections.Specimen: Pancreaticoduodenectomy comprising pancreatic head and uncinate process, duodenum, distal common bile duct, gallbladder and regional lymph nodes.
sections.Gross description: Received fresh, orientated and inked. An ill-defined, firm, grey-white mass is centred on the pancreatic head, measuring 26 mm in greatest dimension. The superior mesenteric artery margin is 2 mm from the tumour. The pancreatic neck margin is clear, 8 mm from the tumour. The bile duct margin is clear, 6 mm from the tumour. The gallbladder and duodenum are unremarkable. Seventeen lymph nodes are identified and submitted. Representative sections are taken from the tumour, all margins and all lymph nodes.
sections.Microscopic description: Infiltrating irregular glands and small clusters of moderately differentiated ductal adenocarcinoma are present in a dense desmoplastic stroma. The tumour is confined to the pancreas, with no extrapancreatic extension. Perineural invasion is present. Lymphovascular invasion is present. Metastatic carcinoma is identified in 3 of 17 regional lymph nodes. The margins are free of tumour, the closest being the superior mesenteric artery margin at 2 mm.
sections.Diagnosis:
Pancreas, pancreaticoduodenectomy:
- Moderately differentiated ductal adenocarcinoma of the pancreatic head, 26 mm (pT2).
- Metastatic carcinoma in 3 of 17 regional lymph nodes (pN1).
- Perineural and lymphovascular invasion present.
- Margins free of tumour; closest margin is the superior mesenteric artery at 2 mm.
sections.Synoptic summary:
Tumour size: 26 mm
Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
Margins: Free of tumour; closest margin superior mesenteric artery, 2 mm
Lymphovascular invasion: Present
Perineural invasion: Present
Lymph nodes (positive/total): 3/17
pT: pT2
pN: pN1
Staging edition: AJCC 8th edition
sections.Comment: Pathological stage group IIB (pT2 pN1; M category not assessed in this specimen), AJCC 8th edition. Clinical correlation is advised for any further staging and for adjuvant treatment planning at the multidisciplinary meeting.
